basic_info.description: Welcome to the coastal living in San Francisco's Sunset District. This classic mid-century, Outer Sunset home offers two bedrooms and one bath, a spacious living/dining room combo, and kitchen on the main level. Lower level has rooms and a bath, car garage with ample storage and laundry area. Fresh interior & exterior paint, remodeled kitchen w/ stainless steel appliances, granite counter tops and refinished hardwood floor. Situated on a sizable lot, this home has plenty of outdoor space; ideal for gardening, gatherings and family enjoyment. Located just blocks from nearby outdoor activities such as Ocean Beach, the Golden Gate Park, Lands End,  SF Zoo, Stern Grove, and the vibrant Noriega Street Corridor filled with some of the most flavorful cafes, restaurants, shops, and local community Supermarket. A relaxing-vibe neighborhood with endless-ocean-fresh air and beautiful sunsets in the evening, makes it one of the city's affordable secret and most desirable communities in San Francisco. With some creativity and vision, this home provides room to create the coastal living lifestyle, a charming family home or a retreat for years to come. With easy Muni and freeway access to Downtown San Francisco, the Peninsula and the Silicon Valley for work or play, don't miss it!
